import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')
except FileNotFoundError:
    # Create a dummy dataframe for placeholder execution if file is not found
    print("Warning: 'data/dogs_zurich.csv' not found. Generating a placeholder plot with dummy data.")
    data = {
        'StichtagDatJahr': [2015, 2015, 2016, 2016, 2017, 2017, 2018, 2018, 2019, 2019, 2020, 2020, 2021, 2021, 2022, 2022, 2023, 2023, 2024, 2024],
        'Rasse1Text': ['Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua', 'Labrador', 'Chihuahua'] * 5,
        'AnzHunde': [1] * 100
    }
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    for i in range(8): # Add 8 more dummy breeds
        df_dummy = pd.DataFrame({
            'StichtagDatJahr': df['StichtagDatJahr'].unique().tolist() * 2,
            'Rasse1Text': [f'DummyBreed_{i+1}'] * 20,
            'AnzHunde': [1] * 20
        })
        df = pd.concat([df, df_dummy], ignore_index=True)


# Data Preparation
# Identify the top 10 most popular breeds over the entire period
top_10_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index

# Filter the dataframe to include only the top 10 breeds
df_top10 = df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_10_breeds)].copy()

# Aggregate the data: count dogs per breed per year
breed_trends = df_top10.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text'])['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Visualization
# Set the style and create the figure
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9))

# Create the line plot
sns.lineplot(
    data=breed_trends,
    x='StichtagDatJahr',
    y='AnzHunde',
    hue='Rasse1Text',
    palette='tab10',
    linewidth=2.5,
    ax=ax
)

# Customization and Labeling
# Set title and axis labels
ax.set_title('Popularity Trends of Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12, labelpad=10)

# Format x-axis to show integers for years
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MaxNLocator(integer=True))
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Improve the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(handles, labels, title='Breed', bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# Add annotations to highlight the most popular breed
# Find the most popular breed in the last year of data
last_year = breed_trends['StichtagDatJahr'].max()
last_year_data = breed_trends[breed_trends['StichtagDatJahr'] == last_year]
most_popular_last_year = last_year_data.loc[last_year_data['AnzHunde'].idxmax()]

ax.text(
    most_popular_last_year['StichtagDatJahr'] + 0.1,
    most_popular_last_year['AnzHunde'],
    f"{most_popular_last_year['Rasse1Text']}",
    fontsize=10,
    fontweight='bold',
    color=ax.get_lines()[labels.index(most_popular_last_year['Rasse1Text'])].get_color(),
    va='center'
)

# Set y-axis to start from 0 and add some padding
ax.set_ylim(0)
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=10)

# Add a subtle grid
ax.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# Final layout adjustments
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1]) # Adjust layout to make space for the legend

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
